senses.gloss:
वैहायस वैहायस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विहायस्),
being in the air, aerial, suspended in the air; (अस्),
m., N. of a lake.

वैहार्य वैहार्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-हार), to
be played or sported with, to be conciliated by
pleasantry (applied to a wife's brother or brother-in-
law or other relations of a wife).

वैहासिक वैहासिक, अस्, m. (fr. वि-हास), a
comic actor, buffoon; an actor (in general).
